tagline: Sync ClickUp task deadlines to Google Calendar and create tasks from calendar events
metaTitle: Google Calendar + ClickUp Integration: Due Dates as Events
metaDescription: Sync ClickUp due dates to Google Calendar and create tasks from events. GAIA moves events when deadlines shift. See the setup steps.
intro:
ClickUp is your team's project hub, packed with tasks, deadlines, and dependencies across multiple spaces and lists. Meanwhile, you and your stakeholders manage time in a calendar. The problem is that task deadlines rarely make it onto anyone's calendar unless someone manually creates an event — which means important deadlines are invisible to anyone not actively checking the project hub.

GAIA bridges Google Calendar and ClickUp so deadlines are always calendar-visible. Task due dates from the lists you care about appear automatically as calendar events, giving you and your team a deadline view alongside your meetings and appointments. When a calendar event represents a deliverable, GAIA can create the corresponding task so your project management stays in sync with your schedule.

This integration helps project managers who review schedules in the calendar but manage work in spaces and lists, and individual contributors who want their task deadlines surfaced in the calendar they already live in.

useCases.title: Sync ClickUp task due dates to Google Calendar
useCases.description: GAIA monitors for tasks assigned to you and creates corresponding calendar events at the due date, giving you a timeline view of upcoming deadlines alongside your meetings.

useCases.title: Create tasks from calendar events
useCases.description: When you add a calendar event that represents a deliverable, a client presentation, a product demo, or a project kickoff, GAIA creates a linked task in the appropriate space and list so the work gets tracked.

useCases.title: Update calendar events when ClickUp deadlines shift
useCases.description: If a task's due date is changed, GAIA updates the corresponding calendar event automatically so your calendar view always reflects the current project timeline without manual correction.

useCases.title: Visualize project milestones on a team calendar
useCases.description: GAIA aggregates key milestone tasks across your team's spaces and publishes them to a shared calendar, giving people who don't use ClickUp a clear view of project delivery dates in the tool they already use.

useCases.title: Time-block for tasks
useCases.description: GAIA can automatically create time-blocked slots for high-priority tasks before their due date, protecting focus time in your calendar so deep work gets scheduled, not just listed.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Calendar and ClickUp to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize your calendar and workspace in GAIA's integration settings using OAuth. You select which spaces, folders, and lists participate in the sync.

howItWorks.step: Configure deadline sync and task creation rules
howItWorks.description: Set which task properties trigger calendar event creation, assignee, priority, list membership, or custom field values. Define which calendar receives the task-sourced events.

howItWorks.step: GAIA maintains the deadline-to-calendar pipeline automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA watches for new and updated tasks and keeps the calendar in sync. When calendar events are created manually that match task templates, GAIA can create the corresponding tasks too.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync start dates as well as due dates to Google Calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can create multi-day events that span from a task's start date to its due date, giving you a visual duration view of each task in your calendar.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support ClickUp's recurring tasks when syncing to the calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA maps recurring task schedules to recurring calendar events. When the recurrence pattern changes, GAIA updates the calendar recurrence rule accordingly.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync tasks from multiple workspaces to one calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA supports multiple workspaces and can route events from different workspaces to separate calendars or consolidate them into one, depending on your preference.
